name: What types of damaged boards can Frasheski Construction replace?

mainEntity.name: What types of damaged boards can Frasheski Construction replace?

acceptedAnswer.text: Frasheski Construction specializes in replacing various types of damaged boards, including siding, deck boards, subflooring, and trim. The specific type of board and the extent of damage will influence the replacement approach. For example, dry rot requires a different remediation strategy than simple water damage. We assess the material, the cause of the damage, and the structural implications to ensure a comprehensive repair.
acceptedAnswer.description: Frasheski Construction replaces damaged siding, deck boards, subflooring, and trim. The approach depends on the material and damage type.
